verdict.rationale: The founder describes Zero as an AI-powered email client with a built-in assistant. It auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox, and the repo calls Zero an 'AI email solution'. That is the product's own in-app AI capability. However, the only source for it is a single founder post, with no first-party docs on what tasks the assistant can actually carry out. The MCP.md capability list describes the external MCP server, not the in-app assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the in-app assistant, evidence it can execute actions such as archive, label, send or bulk operations from chat, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
